name: Quiet Pug 68
author: Peary74
description: Dark rounded amber radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from #2e2f33 to #ffdf6a, border-radius becomes 100px, background changes from #2e2f33 to #cacaca. Clicking it toggles it: z-index becomes 1, top becomes 3px, left becomes 30px.
